newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Report on Dec 12 computer glitch soon - HK bourse.
newsitem.headline: Report on Dec 12 computer glitch soon - HK bourse.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong said on Thursday that a report on a computer glitch on December 12 which erroneously showed a four percent drop in the Hang Seng index was almost complete.

"The consultancy's report is almost complete and I am in touch with the consultancy and it is expected that in the coming week we will receive that report," deputy chief executive Alec Tsui told a news conference.
He said although he had seen initial comments from the report "it is premature at this point today to talk about that".
The Hang Seng Index, calculated by HSI Services Ltd using data from the exchange, appeared to fall more than 500 points in the opening minutes of trade on December 12.
The Exchange said last month that a software bug in a file backup-restore macro was responsible for the error.
